name: Cartographer
summary: Claude Code plugin and CLI that maps codebases with parallel AI subagents and writes docs/CODEBASEMAP.md.
description: Cartographer analyzes a repository — either by indexing it into a local SQLite graph or by orchestrating parallel Sonnet subagents — and produces documentation: docs/CODEBASEMAP.md, a CLAUDE.md summary, bounded agent briefs and removal/completeness audits. The v2 CLI adds index, brief, verify, audit, notes and adoption commands plus an MCP stdio wrapper; update mode re-analyzes only changed modules.
contains: indexes a repo into .cartographer/graph.sqlite with incremental file-hash caching
MCP stdio wrapper exposing index, brief, view, verify, audit and notes tools
parallel Sonnet subagents (1M token context) split by token budget
update mode re-analyzes only changed modules
